title: 05 promotion, https://use05.dev/promotion/v0
description: An in-toto Statement v1 recording that one exact commit moved into an environment: from where, how, the rollback point, each promotion rule's result, and the bypasses and sign-offs it went with. Subject: the source commit (gitCommit). Signed by the CI runner key, or by the key of the machine that promoted. Fields are only ever added, as optional ones.

rule.description: source_checks, source_confirmed, soak, migrations, untasked or sign_off.

severity.description: allow, warn, approval or deny; a newer 05 may add values, which readers treat as unknown.

outcome.description: pass, fail, bypassed or skipped; a newer 05 may add values, which readers treat as unknown.

env.description: The environment or destination promoted into.

from.description: The environment promoted from. For a hotfix, the environment itself: the work started from its branch and landed back on it. For a destination, the environment its source branch is, else that branch.

direction.description: up, back or hotfix; a newer 05 may add values, which readers treat as unknown.

source_commit.description: The exact commit that was evaluated and moved.

target_before.description: The target branch's head before; absent when the promotion created the branch.

how.description: fast-forward, merge, or revert for a revert 05 made; push or export for a destination. For an export, result_commit is the commit made in the destination repository, and target_before its branch head there.

rollback_point.description: The commit to go back to if the deploy fails; absent when there was none.

bypasses.description: The receipts of the bypasses it went with, by path.

signoffs.description: The receipts of the sign-offs it went with, by path.

by.description: Who promoted: a person, or the agent or CI that did.

reverts.description: Only on a revert 05 made, because a deploy was not confirmed or a person ran use05 promote <env> --rollback: the commit it reverts, which was the branch's head. The revert commit is then source_commit and result_commit, and how is revert.

task.description: Only on a hotfix (direction hotfix): the 05 task whose work landed straight on the environment's branch.
